hypotheses.statement: Interchanging loops from i-j-k to i-k-j converts the inner loop access to matrices B and C from strided column traversal (stride 128 elements = 512 bytes) to unit-stride contiguous row traversal (stride 4 bytes), eliminating cache line thrashing.
supporting_evidence: Static inspection confirms B[k * N + j] has stride 1 along inner loop index j.
Row-major layout stores adjacent row elements in adjacent bytes on the same 128-byte cache line.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate achieves > 2.0x speedup over baseline at N >= 128.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed: Continuous row-major memory stride eliminated column-strided cache penalties (9.42x).

hypotheses.statement: Unit-stride access in the inner loop enables Clang/LLVM loop vectorizer to generate ARM64 NEON 128-bit vector fused multiply-add (fmla) instructions, processing 4 single-precision floats per cycle per execution pipeline.
supporting_evidence: Clang optimization remark confirmed: 'vectorized loop (vectorization width: 4, interleaved count: 4) [-Rpass=loop-vectorize]'.
Reference i-j-k explicitly missed vectorization: 'the cost-model indicates that vectorization is not beneficial'.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate GFLOP/s increases by > 3x compared to baseline.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed by 9.42x measured speedup, consistent with 4-way NEON SIMD vectorization.

hypotheses.statement: Tiling matrices into 64x64 sub-blocks restricts the active working set to 3 * (64x64) * 4 bytes = 48 KB, fitting within the Apple M4 L1 Data Cache (64 KB). This prevents capacity cache evictions as N increases.
supporting_evidence: Apple M4 L1d cache size is 65,536 bytes (64 KB).
For N >= 512, full matrices exceed L1d capacity (512x512 = 1 MB, exceeding L1d).
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Blocked candidate maintains throughput stability at large sizes (N >= 512).

hypotheses.statement: Hand-written ARM NEON intrinsics using 4x4 register blocking keep 4 independent vector accumulators live in 128-bit NEON registers, hiding pipeline execution latency and saturating dual FMA pipelines.
supporting_evidence: Kernel uses vld1q_f32, vfmaq_f32, and vst1q_f32 directly from arm_neon.h.
Direct instruction control bypasses compiler heuristic register allocation.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Explicit NEON candidate matches or outperforms auto-vectorized candidate without regressions.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed by 11.43x measured speedup, consistent with 4-way NEON SIMD vectorization.

hypotheses.statement: Distributing matrix row blocks across independent CPU cores using C++20 concurrency delivers near-linear scaling when computation time exceeds thread creation and join latency.
supporting_evidence: Row-block partitioning guarantees disjoint write sets with zero inter-thread locks.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate achieves > 2.0x speedup over single-threaded candidate for N >= 256.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed: Multithreaded parallel scaling delivered 23.94x speedup across CPU cores.

hypotheses.statement: Pathological j-k-i column-strided traversal on row-major matrices creates maximum spatial cache misses and instruction stalls, demonstrating that Axiom's decision engine correctly identifies regressions.
supporting_evidence: Column stride N * 4 bytes forces a new cache line read on every innermost iteration.
Inversion forces column strided write-backs to memory.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate exhibits > 2x latency degradation relative to baseline and is rejected.
